summary: This bill adds a new section to title 14 of the U.S. Code that automatically appropriates funds to continue Coast Guard military pay and allowances, qualified civilian and contract employee pay and benefits, and certain death gratuities and housing allowances whenever Coast Guard appropriations lapse but Defense Department funding has been enacted, until regular or continuing appropriations are passed or other termination triggers occur.

This directly engages government spending by ensuring funds flow without new congressional action, maintaining or continuing spending levels rather than reducing them.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax rates, credits, deductions, or revenue collection of any kind.
